name: Avelisse
summary: Avelisse is upholstered in finely textured fabric that enhances the seat and back with softness and refined detail. The design is elevated on straight brushed brass-finished legs, bringing warmth and a subtle glow to its clean silhouette. Balanced between comfort and elegance, it carries a timeless presence that enriches both modern and classic interiors. 65x59x81
